question_too_long: The question is too long: {length} characters, at most {limit} are allowed. Please shorten the question and put the details in the system description field.
description_too_long: The description is too long: {length} characters, at most {limit} are allowed. Please shorten it to what matters for the classification: purpose, area of use, affected persons, your role.
description_empty: Please describe the AI system: what it does, who uses it and who is affected by its results.
rate_limited: Too many requests from this address: {limit} requests per minute are allowed. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.
running_as_root: The service is running with administrator rights (root). An error in the service then affects the whole system. In the container, the user app (ID 10001) prevents this.
debug_enabled: The environment variable {name} is set ({value}). In debug mode, internal details can leak to the outside — switch it off in production.
two_llm_keys: The environment holds API keys for two LLM providers. The service uses the first one it can reach — to use a specific model, set COMPLIANCE_HELPER_MODEL explicitly.
